channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Anthropic pitches $30 trillion addressable market, nearly the size of the entire US economy
item.description: As the Claude maker reportedly prepares for a $2 trillion IPO, it is pitching investors on an addressable market roughly equal to the entire U.S. GDP.

item.title: Tim Curry, star of 'Rocky Horror Picture Show' and 'Home Alone 2,' dies at 80
item.description: Curry died Tuesday evening at his Los Angeles home, his manager and friend confirmed.

item.title: Meta's $18 billion settlement excludes child protections New Mexico won at trial, AG says
item.description: Raúl Torrez said New Mexico secured stronger protections against AI chatbots and predators than the national settlement. Child safety experts agree.

item.title: ChatGPT can now search years of texts, but experts worry about those who never opted in
item.description: A single user can grant AI access to years of conversations without consent from others involved.
